notes.title: Patch 1.1.0 Released
notes.notes:
Patch 1.1.0 Released.
Adding Chinese and Traditional Chinese language support.

notes.title: Version 1.0.9
notes.notes:
UI
	- Fixed dropdowns cutting off top and bottom entries
	- Expanded dropdown selection size
	- Fixed character select menu breaking in editor
	- Added extra null checks to prevent HUD from staying disabled

Subtitles
	- Minor spelling/punctuation fixes

Cutscenes
	- Fixed numerous cutscene issues
Levels
	- Added Malkov confrontation cutscene
	- Added missing dialogue
	- Added ambush encounter 
	- Fixed overlapping cutscenes cutting each other off
	- Adjusted truck push dialogue to time better in sequence
	- Fixed final cutscene always enabling, regardless of whether it was previously played
	- Moved rail electricity effect, since it doesn't do anything and might dissuade players from the critical path
	- Removed trigger for nonexistent memory dialogue
	- Covered up void hole at level exit
	- Adjusted timing on some end level dialogue
	- Added debug tool to destroy artillery camp
        - Fixed hint guide system
	- Adjusted War activation timing to better match dialogue length
	- Minor War activation fix
	
Languages
        -  Added Portuguese translation

Loading Scene
	- Version number will now match Project version number 
Misc
       -	Barrier text won't appear after conditions have been met
       -	Fixed combination barriers breaking if game is loaded after defeating pre-spawned enemies

notes.title: Patch Notes Version 1.0.7
notes.notes:
[b]Balance[/b]
Increasing Bat and Heavy Health values for longer interactions 
Added 'hint' mortar shots
When players aren't near any active artillery camps, a stray mortar shell will occasionally fly by from the direction of an uncleared cam.  This shell has a longer lasting smoke trail, in the hopes of leading players towards the camp
Fixed issue where character health was set from wrong source
Increasing health of Demon Dogs and Heavy Grunts to be more reflective of their physical size/aggressiveness

[b]Enclaves[/b]
Added opening instructions text
Added delay between level load and enemy spawn
Added results/reward text before reloading level
Buffed rewards on timed enclave
Enclaves can now spawn between different random encounters
Added more encounters
Adjusted existing encounter difficulty
Rebalanced rewards
Fixed enemies not spawning if enclave checkpoint data is not cleared properly
All remaining enemies will die on enclave success

notes.title: Version 1.0.6
notes.notes:
Tutorial 
	Tutorial messages now update to use current controller mapping
	Added tutorials for Active Reloading, Respawning, Switching Characters, Cover System, Powers, Grenade use
Balance
	Balance to enemy health values and new health scaling for difficulty settings
	New balance for boss battles
Level loading
	Skip initial cutscenes if save file already exists
Level 8
	Added clearer level instructions
Fixed navmesh to prevent enemies spawning inside objects
	Added new effects
	Improved hit colliders
	Fixed cannon colliders

notes.title: Version 1.0.5
notes.notes:
Camera Shake
	- Fixed camera moving to first player view in coop during screenshake
	- Fixed camera angle not resetting properly during more intense screenshake
Options
	- Fixed options menu coming up blank
	- Fixed audio settings not saving/loading properly
        - Added option to disable screenshake
	- Added option to disable controller vibration
	- Added option to disable mouse cursor during gameplay
	- Fixed error when changing  gore settings on main menu
Cursor
	- Cursor is invisible during cutscenes
	- Cursor is invisible during dialogue events

[b]Boss Updates[/b]

Famine
[list]
[*] Offset physical attack colliders so attacks won't miss players
[*] Adjusted power cast positions so effective range isn't lost
[*] Adjusted vomit collision plane
[/list]
Pestilence
[list]
[*] Thrown corpses spawn further away to prevent collision with Pestilence
[*] Adjusted surrounding scenery to mitigate clipping
[/list]
War
[list]
[*] Increased block size to prevent bullets from going under shield
[*] Fixed War sometimes still being damaged when shield is hit
[*] Fixed shield starting activated
[*] Increased feel detector range during physical powers to compensate for pushing away closer enemies
[*] Offset physical attack colliders so attacks don't go over player's heads
[*] Reduced cannon power
[*] Adjusted cannon aim
[/list]
